'''Roark Garnet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he operated as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], much to the dismay of his [[Parent/Legends|parents]]. He [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'', until his sister, [[Neena Garnet|Neena]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] gunfighter [[Uul-Rha-Shan]]. Upon her passing, Garnet inherited her [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', and used the ''Moldy Crow'' to pay off a loan that he had been forced to take out from [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to cover his running [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|expenses]]. Styling himself as an adventurer and entrepreneur, Garnet loved the life he led and viewed his lifestyle as true freedom.

Garnet had many adventures throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and often traveled with companions. [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], a [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]], worked with Garnet after stowing away aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], before leaving to join the band [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]]. [[Hawk Carrow]] served as Garnet's most regular co-pilot, as did the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Nagraoao]]. Garnet also traveled with his daughter [[Jill Farseeker|Jill]], her grandfather [[Jackson Farseeker]], and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tantos Dree]]. While he had no [[Politics/Legends|political]] leanings toward either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Garnet hated the Empire for making it hard for him to earn a living through their restrictive laws and edicts, and had several run-ins with their [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] forces and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] agencies. However, the [[Socorran]] was willing to work for the Alliance on at least one occasion when he was contracted to ferry supplies by one of their operatives, [[Selnia Harbright]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|My mom always said that Driver Education course would come in handy.|Roark Garnet|<ref name="RC" />}}
[[File:Moldy_crow.jpg|thumb|left|Garnet's first ship, the ''Moldy Crow'']]
Roark Garnet was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="RC" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="TRG1" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] sometime between [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] and [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]<ref name="Age" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]],<ref name="I67" /> in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for planets which the share the name of their [[Star system/Legends|star system]].</ref> He<ref name="TRG1" /> had a sister, [[Neena Garnet|Neena]], who became a famous [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]].<ref name="DFS2" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he operated as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="TRG1" /> He acquired a [[Starship/Legends|ship]], an [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] named the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|324|Garnet, Roark}}</ref> and traveled the [[Star/Legends|stars]] operating as a [[free-trader]],<ref name="RC" /> self-proclaimed adventurer, and entrepreneur.

Garnet was disowned by his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] over his decision to become a smuggler,<ref name="CSWE" /> as they believed that he was gallivanting around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RC" /> However, after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of struggle, he was unable to make ends meet under the oppressive regime of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE" /> While he dreamed of making one large deal and retiring, the truth was that his main expenditure was bribes to [[Customs Inspector]]s.<ref name="RC" /> Eventually, his operating expenses forced him to take out a loan<ref name="CSWE" /> of 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="RC" /> [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[Socorran]] was constantly reminded of his debt, along with threats about broken kneecaps.<ref name="RC" />

At some point, Garnet entered a relationship with the [[Jackson Farseeker's daughter|daughter]] of [[Jackson Farseeker]], a retired Imperial [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. The union produced a daughter, [[Jill Farseeker|Jill]], but Garnet lost contact with the family.<ref name="TRG1" /> After his sister Neena was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="DFS2" /> by the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] gunfighter [[Uul-Rha-Shan]],<ref name="CSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> Garnet inherited her stock light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Dorion Discus]]''. With a second ship to his name, Garnet used the ''Moldy Crow'' as payment to settle his debts to Grappa the Hutt.<ref name="DFS2" />

===Smuggler, free-trader, entrepreneur, adventurer===
====Droid troubles====
{{Quote|I picked up a P2 from Devon Fuller (who owed me money). He didn't have the cash so he offered me the droid. Seemed like a good idea at the time.|Roark Garnet's comment on Cynabar's Droid Datalog|<ref name="CFT:D">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="3BBY">In ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', Roark Garnet left comments on the [[P2-series astromech droid]]'s entry in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] dated 32:4:8:05. As explained [[:Template:YearMathGRS|here]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established that there is a two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] difference between the start of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the start of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] year. Therefore, the Galactic Standard Calendar year commences in the third month of the Great ReSynchronization year. The Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], resulting in a difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems. A date of 32:4:8:05 therefore correlates to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] via simple math.</ref> Garnet obtained a [[P2-series astromech droid]] from fellow smuggler [[Devon Fuller]] in exchange for a sum of credits that Fuller owed him. Garnet believed he had the better end of the deal until the [[Unidentified P2-series astromech droid|droid]] misunderstood him during a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] with Imperial ships and lowered his vessel's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. Garnet ended up [[Spacing/Legends|spacing]] the droid, and vowed to have words with Fuller if he ever ran into him again.<ref name="CFT:D" /> Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY">In ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', Roark Garnet left comments on the [[GY-I information analysis droid]]'s entry in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] dated 36:9:3:22. As explained [[:Template:YearMathGRS|here]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established that there is a two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] difference between the start of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the start of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] year. Therefore, the Galactic Standard Calendar year commences in the third month of the Great ReSynchronization year. The Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], resulting in a difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems. A date of 36:9:3:22 therefore correlates to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] via simple math. However, Garnet is referring to the event having taken place "a couple of years ago," leading to a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1BBY]].</ref> Garnet sold several [[GY-I information analysis droid]]s to the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. The University paid for the droids using credits from tuition fees and donations, and were also willing to pay a slight markup. Garnet liked the fact that he could make a legitimate run without interference from [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]].<ref name="CFT:D" />

====Travels with a Wookiee====
Sometime later, Garnet was working with a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Nagraoao]] when they crash-landed on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TRG1" /> in the Outer Rim Territories' [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> Nagraoao was wounded in the crash, and Garnet attempted to cauterize the Wookiee's wound with his blaster since the [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] and all the medical supplies were destroyed in the crash. Nagraoao complained about Garnet's attempt. While piloting the ''Dorion Discus'', Garnet encountered several strange [[Unidentified pyramidal starship|pyramidal ships]], and was attacked by them. The resulting damage was so severe that it took him several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to repair, although the [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion generators]] were left with an odd pinging sound. On the ship's next voyage, Garnet took his Wookiee companion Nagraoao along. The ship encountered a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor storm]], causing more damage to the ''Dorion Discus''. The fusion generator failed, and the two were grateful that the system's [[magnetic bottle]] did not follow suit. Garnet and Nagraoao repaired the damage, but several of the pyramidal ships that had attacked the ''Dorion Discus'' previously appeared around the vessel.<ref name="TRG1" />

====A Wanted Man====
{{Quote|I'm eight years old. I ran away fro home. I wanna be a space pilot, just like my brother Johnny.''"<br />"''Where's Johnny?"''<br />"''I dunno. Gee, Mr. Garnet. Can I drive your space ship?''"<br />"''Forget it, kid.|Jimmy Marvels and Roark Garnet|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
Garnet once encountered the female [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jana Jarel]], engaging her in a [[lightfight]]. Garnet was wounded by Jarel, but managed to dodge a subsequent [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt. At some point, Garnet also fought a failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Jimbo Kinnison]], in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] combat. Garnet wielded a [[Club/Legends|club]], while Kinnison was armed with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. On another occasion, Garnet was hit by a blast from a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. Fearing that he would be mortally wounded, the Socorran placed his trust in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and hoped to survive.<ref name="TRG1" />

On the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> of [[Xerxes]], Garnet intended to enter a [[Unidentified weapons shop|weapons shop]], but was being hunted by the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]]. Believing that there might be ambush waiting for him inside the shop, Garnet staked the place out for an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. Unable to determine whether or not security forces were laying in wait for him, he attempted to convince a local [[Unidentified Human (Xerxes)|citizen]] to enter the establishment for the sum of twenty credits to check on his behalf.<ref name="TRG1" />

Garnet once met an eight-year child by the name of [[Jimmy Marbels]] who was searching for his brother, [[Johnny Marbels|Johnny]]. By that point, Garnet was wanted in seven [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] on the charges of "pillage and rapine," although the smuggler contended it was merely a misunderstanding between himself and intolerant Imperial officials. Marbels asked to fly Garnet's ship, to which the smuggler replied in the negative.<ref name="TRG1" />

====Alien Encounters====
{{Quote|I tell you now, Garnet. You bad smuggler. Verr bad. Make Mogroch angry.''"<br />"''Mogroch's got to wait. I&hellip;''"<br />"''No wait! Wait long enough. Two days, Garnet. Two days, 10,000 credits. Two days to live for you.|A Muur threatens Roark Garnet over a debt the smuggler owes to Mogroch|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
Garnet incurred a debt of 10,000 credits to a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] named [[Mogroch]]. Mogroch sent a [[Muur]] after Garnet, who used [[Unidentified Muur|its]] [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] to choke Garnet while warning him that he had two days to pay his debt. At another [[Time/Legends|time]], in search of information on the location of Jackson Farseeker, Garnet visited a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was also being tended by members of a hive-minded [[Unidentified hive-mind insectoid species|insect species]]. After using a pile of credits to jog their memories, the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] told him that Farseeker had been in the bar less than seven hours previously in the presence of a [[Unidentified tentacled alien|tentacled alien]] whose species they did not know.<ref name="TRG1" />

Garnet once attempted to enter the [[Contumely Club]], but was blocked by a Wookiee [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] named [[Urartu]]. When Garnet tried to explain that he was supposed to meet someone inside, Urartu's translator, a [[Unidentified small sentient creature|small creature]] sitting on the Wookiee's shoulder that Garnet had assumed was a pet, informed him that no Humans or [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were allowed in the establishment.<ref name="TRG1" />

On another occasion, Garnet was [[Prison/Legends|incarcerated]] in a [[Detention area|detention cell]] and attempted to persuade a droid named [[M-3PO (Jarstein)|M-3PO]] to strangle the [[Unidentified guard (Roark Garnet)|sleeping guard]] with a [[feather boa]] during an escape attempt. M-3PO fretted over inflicting harm to a living being despite Garnet's protestations that he wasn't really attacking the guard since he was [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]]. The droid's worrying woke the guard.<ref name="TRG1" />

While visiting the planet [[Spee]],<ref name="TRG1" /> in the [[Saijo sector/Legends|Saijo sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories,<ref name="TEA-OC" /> Garnet was accosted by a [[Unidentified lizard-like alien|lizard-like alien]] as he left the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] offered to act as Garnet's guide during his time on the planet.<ref name="TRG1" />

At a bazaar on [[Unidentified planet (Outreachial)|another planet]], Garnet kept losing [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and wondered why the natives were kleptomaniacs to a local [[Unidentified bazaar seller|merchant]]. The [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] replied that it was not the natives who had stolen the devices, but the [[Lizardfly|lizardflies]] who nested in the cliffs above [[Outreachial]], many days' travel from the market.<ref name="CP" />

====Passing on Advice====
{{Quote|That was ''you''? I remember you punks very well. If I were you, I'd get off Ord Mantel; I'll be looking for you, grubber. (Got to hand it to you though&hellip;it was a good con.)|Roark Garnet's comments on Gundark's Gear Datalog|<ref name="GFTPG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0ABY">In [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)|''Cynabar's Droid Datalog'']] in ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14]]'', Roark Garnet left comments on the [[Class I Defense Droid]] entry in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] dated 35:5:2:11. As explained [[:Template:YearMathGRS|here]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established that there is a two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] difference between the start of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the start of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] year. Therefore, the Galactic Standard Calendar year commences in the third month of the Great ReSynchronization year. The Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], resulting in a difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems. Dates occurred after 35:3 therefore correlates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] via simple math.</ref> Garnet commented on the entry for [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms']] [[Class I Defense Droid]] in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. After fellow commentators [[Vox (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Vox]] and [[Ransom (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Ransom]] relayed information that the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] were using a number of the droids against the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]], Garnet stated his plans to smuggle weapons to the Trianii. He put out a call for fellow smugglers and an expert in droid [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] to assist him in hitting an Espo ordnance depot. Interested parties were directed to contact Garnet at [[Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe]] on the planet [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]]. Garnet admitted it was a high-risk, high reward run with the added benefit of having fun by facing off against Espos.<ref name="CDD14">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>

Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="1ABY">In ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', Roark Garnet left comments on the [[GY-I information analysis droid]], [[Elegance message drone]], and [[Wanderer Scout Surveyor]] entries in [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] dated 36:9:3:22, 36:4:3:03, and 36:9:6:31. As explained [[:Template:YearMathGRS|here]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established that there is a two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] difference between the start of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the start of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] year. Therefore, the Galactic Standard Calendar year commences in the third month of the Great ReSynchronization year. The Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], resulting in a difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems. Dates occurred after 36:3 therefore correlates to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] via simple math.</ref> Garnet submitted several comments to ''[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]'' regarding his experiences with various droid models, including the GY-I information analysis droid and the [[Elegance message drone]]. He also later wondered if a [[Wanderer Scout Surveyor]] droid, stripped of its [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] and [[Doctor/Legends|medical]] subroutines, could store hidden data such as smuggling routes within its [[Computer/Legends|computer]] matrix. Garnet had not caught up with Fuller over the P2 astromech droid incident, although fellow ''Cynabar's Droid Datalog'' commenters [[Toria Tell]] and [[Callin]] reminded Fuller of Garnet's interest in him through postings on the [[Datalog/Legends|datalog]].<ref name="CFT:D" />

At some point, Garnet was the victim of a scam where smugglers posing as stormtroopers would confiscate illegal cargo from other smugglers. Garnet only found out that it was a scam<ref name="GFTPG" /> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Dating">In ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', Roark Garnet left comments on the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle's]] entry in [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] dated 45:4:09:9. As explained [[:Template:YearMathGRS|here]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established that there is a two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] difference between the start of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the start of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] year. Therefore, the Galactic Standard Calendar year commences in the third month of the Great ReSynchronization year. The Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], resulting in a difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems. A date of 45:4:09:9 therefore correlates to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] via simple math.</ref> when [[Tillin'natiri]] recounted the deception in the comments section of [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]'s entry on the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. Still remembering the scam, Garnet warned Tillin'natiri to get off [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] because he was going to be looking for them and their associates. However, he did admit it was a good con.<ref name="GFTPG" />

====Stowaway====
[[File:Yowza.png|thumb|right|150px|Joh Yowza, the Yuzzum stowaway]]
Some time prior to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. As [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]] is already on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba Palace]], these events must have occurred prior to 4 ABY.</ref> Garnet visited the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]<ref name="SWTSSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="TEA-OC" /> While there, one of the native [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzums]] named [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]] sneaked aboard Garnet's ship looking for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and became trapped aboard the vessel when it left the moon. Garnet discovered the stowaway and took a liking to the alien, especially his [[Musician/Legends|singing]]. The smuggler nicknamed Yowza "Furball," and the Yuzzum helped Garnet out by performing menial chores around the ship such as cooking and cleaning, all the while learning [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. During a layover on the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="SWTSSE" /> in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="TEA-OC" /> Yowza wandered away from the ship and was attracted to the [[Music/Legends|music]] emanating from a local [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]]<ref name="SWTSSE" /> called [[Uncle Chesko's]],<ref name="I67" /> which was being performed by [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]]. Yowza began singing along with the band, and was hired by the band leader, [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]].<ref name="SWTSSE" />

===Imperial entanglements===
====Bathysphere Encounter====
{{Quote|There's a thousand atmospheres out there! The hull can't stand much more. Let me fly this thing or we're all dead men!|An Imperial to Roark Garnet aboard the bathysphere|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
At some point in his career, Garnet was aboard an Imperial [[bathysphere]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Unidentified Jovian planet|Jovian gas giant]]. An altercation occurred on the vessel, pitting Garnet against the Imperial crew and causing the bathysphere to lose control and plunge deeper into the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. Garnet managed to subdue all but [[Unidentified Imperial (bathysphere)|one Imperial]], and the two wrestled for control of the vessel. The Imperial elbowed Garnet away from the wheel, gaining the upper hand, and arrested their descent while attempting to stabilize the bathysphere. Garnet wrenched control of the bathysphere back from the Imperial when he noticed a [[Unidentified flying life form|gray, flying life form]] above them, and avoided a collision by [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]]. Suddenly, the bathysphere's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] failed, exposing Garnet and the Imperial to the full [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of the planet.<ref name="TRG1" />

Although the Imperial was stunned and believed that they were doomed, he directed Garnet to the craft's repulsors at the smuggler's insistence. Struggling against the increased gravity, Garnet made his way to the bathysphere's aft section and managed to fix the bathysphere's repulsorlift to avoid being crushed to death. As the Socorran approached the bathysphere's control cabin, he heard the Imperial change the setting on his blaster. Realizing the temporary truce that had manifested itself during the stabilization of the bathysphere was over, Garnet drew his own weapon and leapt through the doorway firing. His first shot missed, and the Imperial returned fire, forcing Garnet to dodge the blast.<ref name="TRG1" />

====''Regina Cayli''====
{{RPGseed}}
{{Quote|They'll seal the exits when they find I'm gone.''"<br />"''What, you expect me to claw my way through the hull or something?''"<br />"''No, but its not too much to ask that you think, is it?''"<br />"''Nice talk from a rescued guy being carried by his heroic buddy&hellip;|Hawk Carrow and Roark Garnet|<ref name="RC" />}}
During the Galactic Civil War, Garnet and his co-pilot [[Hawk Carrow]] made an unscheduled delivery to the planet [[New Bakstre]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="TEA-OC" /> During the delivery, Imperial Customs [[Guardian-class light cruiser|cruisers]] forced the ''Dorion Discus'' to crash into a forest on the surface. The ''[[Regina Cayli]]'', an [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]], was dispatched to investigate the crash. Deploying [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], they discovered Carrow, and proceeded to wound and capture him, taking him back to the ''Regina Cayli''. Garnet subsequently infiltrated the vessel through an open and unguarded [[Entry ramp/Legends|landing ramp]], freeing his co-pilot from the ship's [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]]. Escaping from the ship, Garnet and Carrow had to figure out a way off the planet as the ''Dorion Discus'' had been disabled in the crash, and they were certain that more stormtroopers would be waiting for them at the crash site. Carrow suggested returning to the ''Regina Cayli'' and stealing the transport, which Garnet considered to be a bad idea.<ref name="TRG1" />
{{Endgame}}

====Imperial Attention====
{{Quote|Keep your armor on, bounty hunter. I'll take care of this. ''Assessor'', this is ''Dorion Discus''. Ah, negative on customs inspection. We have a priority cargo for the Imperial base on Markon IV. Our priority authorization is filed on Thorgeld.|Roark Garnet attempts to bluff the customs frigate ''Assessor''|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
Garnet later reconnected with his daughter, Jill, and was traveling aboard the ''Dorion Discus'' with her, her grandfather Jackson Farseeker, and the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Tantos Dree]]. After leaving the planet [[Thorgeld I|Thorgeld]], the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']] attempted to conduct an inspection of the vessel. Farseeker advised caution, and Dree made it clear that if the Imperials caught him aboard the ''Dorion Discus'', then he would see to it that Garnet would suffer. Jill recommended hiding Dree by dangling him out of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] tethered to the ship. Dree dismissed the idea and headed to the [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] bay while Garnet attempted to bluff the ''Assessor'', claiming that they were carrying a priority cargo bound for the [[Unidentified Imperial base (Markon IV)|Imperial base]] on [[Markon IV]]. The ''Assessor''{{'s}} crew did not believe Garnet and started firing at the ''Dorion Discus''; Garnet evaded the incoming fire long enough for Farseeker to [[Astrogation/Legends|plot]] a course and jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], although the customs frigate managed to score a grazing hit. While on a [[Unidentified planet (weapons restrictions)|planet]] with strict weapons restrictions, Garnet was asked by an Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial bureaucrat|bureaucrat]] if he had a permit for the sidearm he was carrying. The Socorran was unaware of any need for a permit, which was required to stop traders joyriding and targeting the native population. When the smuggler inquired about how to acquire a permit, the [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] stated that they did not know.<ref name="TRG1" />

====Striking Back Against the Empire====
Garnet once visited a [[Unidentified planet (trinary system)|planet]] in a [[Unidentified trinary system (Roark Garnet)|trinary system]] and got involved in a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] chase with a [[Unidentified stormtrooper (trinary system)|stormtrooper]] through a canyon. After unsuccessfully trying to shake his pursuer, Garnet and his opponent traded blows by slamming their vehicles into one another. As they raced through the canyon, both Garnet and the stormtrooper collided with obstacles. The stormtrooper was killed, while Garnet suffered injuries from a fall. The Socorran also fought against four Imperial stormtroopers at a later time, and managed to dodge blaster fire from all of them.<ref name="TRG1" />

Garnet was additionally involved in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|battle]] with four Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. Despite having already lost his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]], Garnet managed to dodge fire from all four starfighters, then destroy them all in turn. At another point in his career, Garnet learned that his companions Hawk Carrow and Nagraoao had been captured by the Empire and incarcerated in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and Garnet took the ''Dorion Discus'' to rescue them. Once in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]], the ''Dorion Discus'' was intercepted by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and searched. Garnet claimed to be transporting food and spare parts to Kessel, and offered the [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Kessel system)|naval officer]] in charge of the inspection a bribe. The officer accepted Garnet's offering, and allowed the ''Dorion Discus'' to go about its business.<ref name="TRG1" />

====A Taxing Time====
{{Quote|Cut the small talk, Roark. I know you're smuggling, and I'm going to search your ship. But why are you coughing like that?''"<br />"''(''Sniffle.'') Oh, it's (''hack, hack'') nothing, Just a small dose of Merthian lung infection I picked up on Lockest IV.''"<br />"''Uh, Merthian lung infection? It's not serious, is it?''"<br />"''(''Cough, cough.'') Oh, no. It's almost never fatal.|Tax Inspector Mothra and Roark Garnet|<ref name="CP" />}}
Garnet had several encounters with [[Tax Inspector]] [[Mothra]] through his smuggling career. During one meeting, Mothra believed that Garnet was smuggling and wanted to inspect his ship. Garnet, however, pretended to have contracted a phony ailment on [[Lockest IV]] known as [[Merthian lung infection]] which he stated was rarely ever fatal. Fearing contagion, Mothra beat a hasty retreat, leaving Garnet and his co-pilot, Hawk Carrow, to be about their business. Garnet later encountered Mothra again, only to find that he had been promoted to [[Associate Governor]] of the [[Unidentified 26-hour planet|planet]] they had landed on. Revealing he was aware of Garnet's earlier deception, he told an aide to watch the smuggler closely.<ref name="CP" />

Garnet once stole several Elegance message drones from an [[Unidentified Imperial depot|Imperial depot]] near [[Obas]],<ref name="CFT:D" /> in the [[Andirma sector/Legends|Andirma sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The smuggler used the droids to contact wary clients as they were a secure method of communications, and as only outlying [[Imperial garrison (Bestine)|Imperial garrisons]] were equipped with Elegances, Garnet assured that no one intercepted them by using phony Imperial [[transponder]] codes.<ref name="CFT:D" />

====The Void Terror====
{{RPGseed}}
{{Quote|Looks like we pulled out of hyperspace just before we slammed through an asteroid field. It's not on any of the charts. Great. I hate asteroids. Why don't you get yourself up into the topside gun and blast any chunk of rock that comes close enough to hit us. I'm shutting down some of the other main systems so Hawk and I can check out the hyperdrive, make sure nothing's wrong.|Roark Garnet to Selnia Harbright|<ref name="VT">{{JournalCite|3|The Void Terror}}</ref>}}
[[File:Selnia_Harbright_HS.jpg|thumb|left|Selnia Harbright, Alliance operative]]
During the Galactic Civil War, Garnet and Carrow were contracted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operative [[Selnia Harbright]] to transport medical supplies from [[Droecil]]<ref name="VT" /> in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] of the Expansion Region<ref name="TEA-OC" /> to the [[Calus system/Legends|Calus system]]<ref name="VT" /> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> aboard the ''Dorion Discus''. During the loading operation, stormtroopers entered the docking bay, forcing Garnet to take off with Harbright aboard, which had not been part of the initial contract. En route to the Calus system, Garnet decided to take a shortcut through [[Keller's Void/Legends|Keller's Void]], an empty area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="VT" /> in the Inner Rim<ref name="TEA-OC-Keller">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]] and [[Calus system/Legends|Calus system]] both being in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] with [[Keller's Void/Legends|Keller's Void]] laying between them.</ref> that connected the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona]] and Calus systems.<ref name="VT" />

The ''Dorion Discus''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] cut out in the middle of the Void as its [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] that was not on any [[Star map/Legends|charts]]. Garnet requested that Harbright man the topside gun while he and Carrow shut down some of the main systems to inspect the hyperdrive. As Garnet and Carrow worked to repair the ''Dorion Discus'', [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] under the command of [[Black Jack]] attempted to capture the vessel. Garnet and Carrow assisted Harbright in stopping the pirate's attempt to spacejack the freighter and delivered the supplies safely to the Alliance on [[Calus]].<ref name="VT" />
{{Endgame}}

====Aboard the ''Silver Star''====
{{RPGseed}}
{{Quote|Hey &mdash; no way I'm going to wear that thing. No way.''"<br />"''Gee, Roark. You might look cute in ruffles&hellip;|Garnet does not relish the idea of dressing up|<ref name="LOL">{{WEGCite|story=The Lap of Luxury|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>}}
Garnet was once affiliated with the Alliance, conducting a couple of missions for them. Along with other Rebels, he was part of a flight of Alliance ships that successfully destroyed an Imperial [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that was chasing a [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]. Four passengers were rescued from the yacht&mdash;two members of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], an Alliance sympathizer from a noble house affiliated with the Empire, and an Alliance [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]&mdash;and the destruction of the Imperial frigate was staged to look like an accident. The survivors were delivered to a secret Alliance installation.<ref name="LOL" />

The four survivors revealed their mission to meet with the [[Gaddrian ambassador]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Silver Star]]''. The Gaddrian ambassador was sympathetic to the Alliance and wanted to discuss the possibility of establishing a fifth column within the Empire. The members of the Rebel flight, including Garnet, were selected to escort the ambassador to the meeting, disguised as aristocratic travelling companions. The ''Silver Star'' would have a large Imperial presence aboard, and the team was on its own without back up. Garnet did not relish the idea of dressing in anything that included ruffles.<ref name="LOL" />

Aboard the ''Silver Star'', the group met with several Imperial heavies at a formal banquet. Suspecting a trap, Garnet and his companions began to investigate the Imperial presence and found evidence that one of the four individuals rescued from the yacht was actually an Imperial double [[Agent/Legends|agent]]. The group set about eliminating the traitor and ensuring that their charges managed to escape. Garnet and the Rebels managed to evade pursuit and find refuge in the lower decks of the liner where they were aided by members of the crew. Eventually, the team made it to the boat deck, overcame some Imperial guards, and stole a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to escape.<ref name="LOL" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Aw, Roark never could take a joke.|Devon Fuller, as quoted in ''Cynabar's Droid Datalog'', v.4.7.1|<ref name="CFT:D" />}}
Roark Garnet was six [[Foot/Legends|feet]] tall and weighed 180 [[Pound/Legends|pounds]].<ref name="TRG1" /> He sported long sideburns that stretched to his jawline.<ref name="RC" /> Garnet was considered to be good-looking, and had once sported a pencil-thin mustache. A smart but cynical individual who remained calm under pressure, Garnet was a decent businessman.<ref name="TRG1" /> His decision to become a smuggler was not accepted by his parents,<ref name="CSWE" /> but Garnet loved the life. He considered his ship to be his home, and relished the freedom that traveling the stars gave him and would do anything, including borrowing money from a crime lord, to avoid losing it.<ref name="RC" /> Garnet often traveled with companions, and he was a loyal man who risked his life to rescue his friends when they were captured by the Empire.<ref name="TRG1" /> He also allowed the Yuzzum stowaway, Joh Yowza, to stay aboard his ship rather than evict him and took a liking to the being.<ref name="SWTSSE" />

[[File:Garnet-HWK290.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Roark Garnet piloting the ''Moldy Crow'']]
While he dreamed of one day making enough money to get out of the business, Garnet privately admitted that he did not really want to give up the life he led. Holding no love for either the Empire or the Rebel Alliance, the smuggler blamed the former for forcing him into debt with a crime lord due to their restrictive laws and widespread corruption,<ref name="RC" /> but was willing to work for the latter.<ref name="VT" /> Garnet was considered to have a bad sense of humor that did not improve with age,<ref name="TRG1" /> while others, such as Devon Fuller, held the opinion that the smuggler never took a joke well.<ref name="CFT:D" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Well, if you're all intent on suicide &mdash; how about a little fancy piloting to dodge the next shot?|Garnet, at the helm of the ''Dorion Discus''|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
Trained to use a blaster, Garnet was also experienced in both [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed]]<ref name="RC" /> and melee combat.<ref name="TRG1" /> Having passed a [[Driver Education course]] in his youth&mdash;which his [[Roark Garnet's mother|mother]] proclaimed would come in handy one day&mdash;Garnet was an accomplished starship pilot, capable of flying space transports<ref name="RC" /> and starfighters, and was able to recognize ships such as the [[Janako]] model of the [[MaKing-class transport|''MaKing''-class transport]] by sight. He could also ride speeder bikes. Due to his experiences, Garnet was fully capable of repairing starships, and did so on a regular basis. He once managed to increase the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed of his ship by removing a faulty [[hydrovalve]] that had been reducing power to the [[Engine coupling/Legends|engine couplings]].<ref name="TRG1" />

==Equipment==
Roark Garnet owned at least two starships during his career; the HWK-290 light freighter ''Moldy Crow''<ref name="CSWE" /> and the ''Dorion Discus''.<ref name="DFS2" /> After inheriting the ''Dorion Discus'' from his late sister, Garnet used to the ''Moldy Crow'' to pay off his debt to Grappa the Hutt.<ref name="CSWE" /> Garnet carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]],<ref name="RC" /> and stored a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] in a [[Boot/Legends|boot]] sheath. He was known to have a stash of [[Wroonian ale]] aboard the ''Dorion Discus''.<ref name="VT" /> Garnet also carried a [[thesselbeast's foot]], which he believed to be lucky. He typically wore a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] with jeans.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roark Garnet was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1987]]. He was used both as an "example character," illustrating character creation and gameplay for the game,<ref name="TRG1" /> and as the main character in the solitaire adventure [[Regina Cayli (adventure)|''Regina Cayli'']].<ref name="RC" /> Garnet appeared in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[1994]] as the ''Regina Cayli'' adventure was reprinted.<ref name="AJ1">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]]</ref>

Garnet's image was first included in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|second edition]] of ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' released in [[1992]]. Drawn by [[John Paul Lona]], it was used to illustrate the generic smuggler template used for character creation.<ref name="RPG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> In [[1996]], a colorized version of the image was printed in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' and was used to represent [[Blaine Hansom]], who served as the example character for that book.<ref name="RPG-Revised">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> In both the first edition of ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' and ''Regina Cayli'' reprinted in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal 1'', Garnet's character template is based on the generic smuggler character template, with slightly improved statistics to reflect the in-book examples of how to assign skill points during character creation.<ref name="TRG1" />
